blocks.text: The Media Centre has been set up in the campus with the objective of providing in house E Content Preparation Facility which enables quality Video lectures to our students. This Centre helps the faculty in creating high quality Video Lectures and E contents to serve the students.The Centre is supported with advanced Hardware and Softwares tools.
